phase0_scope: Specified acceptance obligations only; native evidence is required before any gate can pass.

gates.preconditions: Installed native server; independent pipe client; no assets required for hello/discovery.
gates.stimulus: Negotiate versions, query capabilities, send malformed/oversized/duplicate messages, reconnect and cancel running operations.
gates.acceptance: Exact schemas and stable errors; no mutation on rejection; bounded memory; one terminal outcome per ID; responsive service and explicit history loss.
gates.artifacts: Wire transcripts; allocation limits; build/schema IDs; operation history.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Same actual Phase 2 native field/event fixture build with display/GPU/input/audio device access denied; the original integrated slice follows in Phase 3.
gates.stimulus: Cold-start, play and query all implemented content in image-free mode; audit device opens and dependency initialization.
gates.acceptance: No device/window/server requirement; same state and legal actions as interactive play; unavailable renderer causes only an explicit image error.
gates.artifacts: Host isolation record; device-access audit; complete action/state trace.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Recovered eligible and ineligible states for each implemented action.
gates.stimulus: Replay simultaneous press/hold/release, axes extremes, implemented menu/dialogue choices, scroll and pointer cases from physical and direct clients. Reject unavailable battle commands; exercise actual battle selection in the Phase 3 regression.
gates.acceptance: Same handler, eligibility, cost and applied tick; atomic invalid-batch rejection; no OS/SDL injection; stale IDs fail.
gates.artifacts: Canonical action traces; per-tick hashes; disabled reasons; handler-path audit.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Every authoritative serializer field inventoried independently against all implemented subsystem schemas.
gates.stimulus: Mutate valid state in each domain, query full and filtered pages while running, expire cursors, diff across restore and exhaust subscriptions.
gates.acceptance: All internal/offscreen state typed and visible; one immutable snapshot per page series; explicit expiry/loss; new unregistered state fails gate.
gates.artifacts: Serializer-to-schema field audit; query/delta transcripts; round-trip hashes; omission negative test.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Controller, trusted debug client, read-only observer and a client without debug authority in one Phase 2 session; no Lua runtime is required.
gates.stimulus: Race cycles and stale guards; hand off with held input; disconnect controller and spectator; attempt forbidden actions, clock control, debug writes and privilege escalation from unprivileged clients. Unavailable Lua operations reject explicitly.
gates.acceptance: One owner; atomic admission; deterministic release/cancel on handoff; controller EOF pauses; spectator has no state effect; no role escalation.
gates.artifacts: Role/ownership matrix; denial traces; handoff ticks; state hashes.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase. Phase 7 owns actual untrusted-Lua escalation tests through P07-T14; a Phase 2 rejection does not count as that later test.

gates.preconditions: Evidence-qualified rational native timebase and deterministic original-qualified trace.
gates.stimulus: Run paused/exact, real-time, fixed and unthrottled modes; stall render/audio, saturate work budget, trigger a never-true predicate and inject worker hang.
gates.acceptance: Every required update retained; identical tick hashes/events; exact stop boundaries and reasons; separate work/tick/wall budgets; no artificial unlocked pacing.
gates.artifacts: Timebase findings; work counters; tick and wall metrics; watchdog report; equivalence traces.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Implemented Phase 2 field/native-event/input boundaries, pending jobs and resumable original/native tasks; exact content identity and isolated save paths.
gates.stimulus: Snapshot, restore in a fresh process, reset and branch; use incompatible schema/content identities; repeat with images off/on. Phase 7 adds incompatible Lua/mod-version cases; no executable mod is required in Phase 2.
gates.acceptance: Exact subsequent state and input order; new epoch invalidates old guards; isolated saves; incompatible restore leaves state unchanged; transient output rebuilt.
gates.artifacts: Snapshot manifest; branch save paths; hashes; compatibility errors; replay record.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase. Phase 3 adds original battle/menu boundaries, Phase 7 adds Lua/mod state, and Phase 8 adds player-facing snapshots/rewind.

gates.preconditions: Trusted debug session and independently recovered script/source correlations.
gates.stimulus: Pause/step tick/task/instruction; hit conditional breakpoint, event break and watchpoint; perform guarded multi-field edit with an invalid last field; induce assertion/crash/hang.
gates.acceptance: Correct stop phase and resume exactly once; full stacks/state; rollback failed edit; unsafe raw access separately privileged; native debugger resolves stacks and memory.
gates.artifacts: Breakpoint/watchpoint trace; before/after diffs; native debugger transcript; failure artifacts and replay.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Both exact source-profile identities, the qualified Phase 2 native field/basic-menu catalog, implemented setup schemas, and no prior save.
gates.stimulus: Cold-create each supported Phase 2 field/event/basic-menu case; test missing assets, invalid position/state, and explicit rejection of unsupported world-map/battle/minigame setup. Query distinct readiness stages.
gates.acceptance: Same loaders/validators as ordinary play; atomic setup; typed dependencies complete; map initialized never implies control; unsupported setup fails; parity backlog remains honest.
gates.artifacts: Parity case results; setup/source/catalog manifest; readiness observations; negative-case state hashes.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Renderer-capable native host and the same trace as GATE-HEADLESS.
gates.stimulus: Attach/detach viewer mid-run, capture while paused, vary resolution/cadence and implemented render settings, stop consumer and saturate queues. Unsupported profiles reject; Phase 5 owns actual Modern/PS1-style/Custom switching.
gates.acceptance: Metadata identifies immutable state; paused capture advances zero ticks; queue at most two; oldest images drop with counts; no forced real-time cap; identical authoritative hashes.
gates.artifacts: Image metadata; drop/queue metrics; equal per-tick traces; viewer transcript.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Native bounded history and private output storage with injected low-space and process-failure cases.
gates.stimulus: Complete, cancel, exhaust budgets, fail assertion and crash a run; reproduce failure from normalized setup/actions.
gates.acceptance: Terminal status cannot be inferred from started/capture; identities, seeds, applied ticks, expected/observed conditions, hashes and available stacks retained; missing artifacts disclosed.
gates.artifacts: Success/failure manifests; replay result; storage-exhaustion and abrupt-death reports.
gates.scope: Phase 2 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Frozen independently observed original field/event/battle/reward/menu/ordinary-save route; GATE-PROTOCOL through GATE-ARTIFACTS passed for implemented systems.
gates.stimulus: Human and plain direct agent clients complete traversal/jump/interaction/dialogue/concurrent event, legal battle/reward/return, menu/equipment and ordinary save/load; debug demonstrations and streamed/unlocked repeats.
gates.acceptance: Original-qualified outcomes; no corrective debug progression or emulator in runtime; device-free actual play; full state/debug/setup; real-time/unlocked hashes equal; optional spectator independent.
gates.artifacts: Original comparisons; complete human/agent traces; all architecture gate results; setup versus ordinary-play classification.
gates.scope: Phase 3 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Each new original/mod/editor subsystem and its independently qualified catalog.
gates.stimulus: Extend schemas, actions, setup, readiness and debug; cold-launch and continuously play its content at unlocked speed with images off/on.
gates.acceptance: No subsystem completion until state/actions/setup/time/debug are exercised through the same runtime; full both-disc coverage cannot be inferred from first slice.
gates.artifacts: Coverage reconciliation; native extension and parity rows; mod-schema evidence; continuous versus setup run classification.
gates.scope: Phase 4 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Recovered PS1 render operations and source-qualified original captures; all rendering backends.
gates.stimulus: Clean-start Modern and toggle each fidelity operation/preset under varied aspect/refresh/filter/culling, including spectator rendering.
gates.acceptance: Stage-correct original fidelity; Modern quirks off; independent settings preserved; identical authoritative state in all combinations.
gates.artifacts: Original and native captures; effective configuration; backend matrix; state hashes.
gates.scope: Phase 5 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.

gates.preconditions: Original matched Mono/Stereo/Wide signals and reviewed intended spatial reference; validated native Wide tap; reviewed decoder/HRTF provenance.
gates.stimulus: Test raw signal, reconstruction and HRTF separately with synthetic phase/polarity/panning and original captures on both discs; level-match listening; restore/accelerate/reconnect on ordinary two-channel devices.
gates.acceptance: Exactly two binaural channels; no invented spatial cues, generic widening or double processing; original modes retained/restored; linked phase/gain and history correct; no external processor required.
gates.artifacts: Original findings; stage signal metrics; listening protocol/results; license review; device/restore traces.
gates.scope: Phase 10 owns the initial executed acceptance for its complete declared checklist scope. Later listed regression tasks extend or requalify the same invariant; they are not prerequisites for the initial phase.
